svg.aria-label: A strip of 252 grey dots, each one a candidate metric, spread between 48 and 59 percent success at picking postseason series winners. A gold circle marks the best at 59.2 percent, scored on the same data that selected it. A green dashed line at 57.7 percent marks plain untuned run differential, sitting inside the crowd of dots. Below, two red markers show what the winner actually achieved when tested honestly: 48.9 percent held out one season at a time, and 56.4 percent when tuned only on prior seasons. Both fall short of the green line.
svg.text: 252 CANDIDATE METRICS, AND WHAT HAPPENED WHEN WE TESTED THEM
Each dot is one way of measuring a club: a blend of season rating and recent form.
Position is how often it picked the winner of a postseason series, 1998–2025.
scored on the same data that chose it
